title: ExportView Shown/Hidden is a box-open bit kept in the session beside the export's own stage
trigger: Start an account export, Hide it, switch account and back, reopen Settings > Data & Storage
effect: No bug today (view is closed by the dialog .close hook and read by the DialogSpec predicate); the box's open state is two places (ExportBox::Options in dialogs and export.view in the session) kept in step by hand
fix: fold the visibility into one ExportBox/ExportStage enum owned per account (OnScreen) instead of a Shown/Hidden bit on the session's export

title: BLOCKED queue keeps an entry for a chat window that closed before its next frame, and a later window for the same chat takes it
trigger: An agent's step opens a hard dialog in a chat window (Blocked{host: Some(chat)} is queued); the user closes that window before its next frame; later the user opens a window for the same chat and opens that same hard dialog by hand
effect: take_blocked_closing_layers partitions by host and screen only, so the stale entry is returned to the new window's shell, which closes the box the user opened (e.g. LogOut); the entry otherwise sits in the thread-local until the screen epoch changes
fix: drop entries whose host window is gone when a window closes (or key them by the window's slot/epoch, not the chat id), or make the queue part of the window's own state so it ends with the window

title: Detached forever-loop minute timer re-applies appearance (and the OS accent) while the window is hidden, locked or logged out; not in the owned-timers baseline
trigger: Launch Quill, lock it or log out, leave it for an hour
effect: 60 wakes an hour of apply_appearance (and refresh_system_accent with the system-accent option) behind the lock/in the background; cheap (apply_appearance only notifies on a change) but it is the `poll` + `detached` shape the guard exists for, and check-owned-timers.py skips this file because its name says demo, so it was never listed
fix: drive auto-night from a wake: observe the OS appearance/accent change and arm one timer for the next schedule boundary held in the appearance state, or poll in a task owned by the account/screen and parked while locked; rename or exclude only the demo parts of app_demo.rs from the guard

title: A custom theme file that failed to read is cached as `None` and not read again until the themes folder changes
trigger: Pick a custom theme as the day theme; at the next launch its file is unreadable for a moment (locked, mid-write by another tool); the read answers `None`
effect: resolve_app_theme falls back to the built-in default for the whole session and custom_cache keeps `(name, None)`; nothing sends the read again (only refresh_custom_themes, after a change made inside Quill, clears the cache)
fix: cache `Fetch<Palette>`-like stage (Ready/Failed) and treat Failed as a miss the next time the appearance is applied, or do not cache a failed read

title: AudioEngine keeps its stage in five fields changed together by hand: track, building, backend, standing, fault
trigger: Start a voice note, seek while it builds, fail the build, then resume (start/land/fail_build/resume/stop each reassign a different subset)
effect: No bug found: the transitions are covered by tests and `state()` derives the stage; but `Standing::Failed` and `Fault::{Seen,Unseen}` both say the last start failed, and `track`/`building`/`backend` decide Idle/Loading/Playing/Ended, so a new transition must update all five consistently (e.g. fail_build sets standing and fault, stop resets four of them but `simulation` is left)
fix: one `Playback` enum: Idle, Building{target,landing,old: Option<Track>,build}, Playing(Track), Held(Track,Fresh|Stale), Ended(Track), Failed{error,told} with the SimRun inside the Simulated variants

title: A background preparation ending never settles close waiters, so a deletion waiting on it sits until the 60 s cap and is Deferred
trigger: Remove an account while its background client is still being prepared (keychain read on a worker) and no other background client runs; the poll loop ends once the cancelled prepare no longer counts as work, then the worker finishes
effect: deletion_wait stays Wait; nothing calls settle_close_waiters when the worker ends (mod.rs:390 only calls prepare.finished); after CLOSE_GIVE_UP the waiter runs with go=false, so the folder stays recorded and is deleted only on the next start, and the key stays in deleting for the run
fix: call settle_close_waiters after prepare.finished (both early-return paths), or make has_work count running preparations

title: EditStage::Loading is a bare mirror of the session's edit-texts fetch, flipped to Editing by hand from frame upkeep
trigger: Open the bot edit box; fill_bot_edit (render upkeep) copies the texts and sets Editing once both are Ready
effect: no bug today; the real stage (session bots.owned.edit name/about Fetch, load_failed) sits beside the dialog's own Loading/Editing and the two are kept in step in fill_bot_edit only
fix: derive loaded from the session fetch, or hold the request id in Loading and settle it in the answer path

title: A looping ringtone is left with its output hold when the screen loses its session
trigger: A call rings on the account on screen (Voice::Looping), then the account logs out or its client closes so session() is None before the next sync
effect: sync_call_sounds returns at the `session()` check and the call tick ends (call_tick_wanted is false), so nobody calls keep_looping(None): the Looping stage and its output Hold stay (audio device held open) until a later sync with a session; the current ring finishes but no new one starts
fix: stop the voice in the screen's Farewell (or when session() is None) instead of relying on the next sync

title: A press that needs a device prompt is dropped without a note while another recording is starting
trigger: Press Call (or answer) with microphone access Undetermined while recording.starting() is true
effect: with_device_access returns at `if self.recording.starting()` and drops `start`; nothing happens and no status note says why, so the call press is silently lost
fix: say why (a note) or queue the start in the recording stage

title: EditMode::replace_as_file (bool) must change in step with the staged replacement it belongs to (ComposerEdit::media_edit.replacement)
trigger: Pick a replacement file while editing a media message, tick 'Send as document'; the replacement is cleared by clear_edit_replacement or a failed probe, and each of those sites resets replace_as_file by hand beside clearing the replacement
effect: No bug today; a new site that drops the replacement but forgets set_edit_replace_as_file(false) leaves the box ticked for the next file
fix: Make the as-file choice a field of the staged replacement value (Replacement { file, as_file }) so dropping the replacement drops the choice

title: checklist / add-tasks / poll-option dialogs close as soon as the request is sent; a server refusal loses the typed content
trigger: Compose a checklist (or Add Tasks, or a poll Add Option), press Create; the driver call returns Ok(request) so the dialog is set to None at once; TDLib then rejects the send (e.g. restricted chat, slow mode, deleted message)
effect: The dialog and everything typed in it are gone; only a generic status note remains, there is no way to retry without retyping
fix: Keep the dialog in a Sending { request: RequestId } stage and close it only on the matching answer; return it to Editing on error

title: CreateVisibility's busy state is read by purpose and chat (has_purpose_for_chat) rather than by the RequestId the box sent; check-request-match.py misses the _for_chat variant
trigger: Press Create on the create-community visibility box while another request of purpose CreateCommunity for the same chat is out (a second window, or the same send from an earlier box)
effect: The Create button shows loading / is disabled for a request this box did not send, and an answer for an earlier request ends the wrong wait
fix: Hold the create's RequestId in the box (CreateVisibility { sent: Option<RequestId> }, or a Creating { request } stage) and read busy from it; extend PURPOSE in scripts/check-request-match.py to has_purpose_for_chat

title: A waiting community ban (CommunitiesUi::ban_waits) can only leave on its member-chats answer; while another box stays open it waits with no cancel or expiry
trigger: Press Ban on a member who owns chats in the community, then open another box (Settings, a profile) and leave it open; the answer arrives and BanStep::Warn keeps returning false while any other dialog is up
effect: Closing that other box later pops the ban warning for a press the user has forgotten, and a ban queued behind it waits too; it needs a confirm, so nothing is banned unseen
fix: Make the wait one stage value with an owner and a cancel (BanWait::Asking { request } -> Warning), dropped when the box it was pressed from goes away
